content.text:
Finding submitted: **deviation** on the indemnity architecture (Art. 16).

- Array's indemnity (16.2) covers only Array Territory product activities, Array-sponsored studies and Article 15 breaches — no third-party IP infringement limb; Article 15 gives no non-infringement warranty and 15.4 disclaims one, and 11.4 leaves each party defending Infringement Actions at its own expense.
- Our indemnity (16.1(a)) sweeps in *all* Third Party Claims from Ono Territory commercialization, including IP claims — the one-way pattern the rule treats as walk-away.
- Redline (validated ok:true): new limb 16.2(e) requiring Array to indemnify for claims that our exercise of the licensed rights or Product activities in the Ono Territory infringe third-party IP, plus a matching carve-out from 16.1(a); fallback (usual exclusions or a cap on that limb) offered in the comment.
